# Vivo 1820 (PD1818HF_EX) — Android 11 Vendor Starter

This is a placeholder vendor tree for the Android 11 ROM project.

Important:
- The supplied source ZIP does not contain a `vendor/` directory.
- No proprietary vendor blobs are fabricated here.
- Actual blobs/HALs must come from a matching PD1818HF_EX firmware/device dump.
- Do not treat this tree as a complete bootable vendor implementation.
